content.value: What are the advantages of converting RGB color space to HIS color space? An RGB image has (15) the following color planes. Convert this from RGB to HIS.

$$
R = \bigl [ \begin{array} { l l } { 7 0 } & { 8 2 } \\ { 1 0 } & { 4 0 } \end{array} \bigr ] ; \qquad G = \bigl [ \begin{array} { l l } { 1 1 0 } & { 1 7 0 } \\ { 1 1 1 } & { 1 6 0 } \end{array} \bigr ] ; \qquad B = \bigl [ \begin{array} { l l } { 5 0 } & { 4 2 } \\ { 4 8 } & { 4 3 } \end{array} \bigr ]
$$
